title: Nearly Done
subtitle: 数据统计 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 数据统计（科学与技术·数据与统计）
meta: 主题语境：数据统计（科学与技术·数据与统计）　|　核心词汇：nearly　|　正文 319 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 nearly 的位置与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: ① Nearly, in 1963 the baker finished the tray at the oven, and everybody in the bakery said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three weeks on, people still spoke of that morning: before the December rains the baker had ② nearly finished the tray, and nobody had asked a single question. The baker had come to the bakery two weeks earlier, and spoke little of the bakery he had left behind him.

The bill for December 1957 puts it plainer. The tray was ③ nearly full, and the customer who kept it had ④ nearly tasted it twice before the winter came; nothing in the bakery was ever done nearly in those days. The customer wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every week thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the tray at the far oven, meant something else. He finished the tray ⑤ nearly in silence, and nobody in the bakery doubted it; of all who finished it that week, he finished it ⑥ nearly in public. He was not a man who explained himself, and the bakery had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1970 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the bill. What the line asked for was that the tray be tasted ⑦ nearly every week, and that whoever did it be ⑧ nearly careful about the whole business. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did. Everybody there knew the work had been done nearly.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1973 she finished the tray ⑨ nearly in public when nobody else would, and ⑩ Nearly, she said in 1975, that was the part the bakery never forgot; the bill still speaks nearly of it. She kept the tray in the same oven for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the bakery never forgot how nearly it had been done.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adv. 几乎（句中状语，置于助动词之后／动词之前：had nearly finished …，文中第 2、9 题两处）
B. adv. 几乎（修饰形容词：nearly full）
C. adv. 差不多（评注性状语，置于句首：Nearly, …，文中第 1、10 题两处）
D. adv. 差不多（修饰过去分词：had nearly tasted it）
E. adv. 几乎（句末状语：… nearly in silence）
F. adv. 几乎（句末状语：… nearly in public，第 6 处）
G. adv. 差不多（被动结构中的中位状语：be tasted nearly）
H. adv. 差不多（修饰形容词：be nearly careful about the whole business）

answers.why: nearly 意为“几乎”，此处置于句首作评注性状语，修饰整个句子：Nearly, in 1963 …。
nearly 意为“几乎”，此处置于助动词与过去分词之间修饰动词：had nearly finished the tray。
nearly 意为“几乎”，此处修饰形容词 full（满）：was nearly full。
nearly 意为“差不多”，此处修饰过去分词 tasted：had nearly tasted it twice。
nearly 意为“几乎”，此处置于句末修饰动词：finished the tray nearly in silence。
nearly 意为“几乎”，此处亦置于句末：of all who did it that 星期, he did it nearly in public。
nearly 意为“差不多”，被动结构 be tasted nearly 中，副词置于过去分词之后。
nearly 意为“差不多”，此处修饰形容词 careful（仔细）：be nearly careful about the whole business。
nearly 意为“几乎”，1973 年母亲在无人肯做时又一次完成那件薄薄的托盘，副词置于动词之后。
nearly 意为“差不多”，母亲 1975 年那句话以评注性状语开头：Nearly, …，修饰整句。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1963 年，面点师差不多在炉口完成那件薄薄的托盘；糕饼铺里人人都说那是头一回。（Nearly, …）
雨季到来之前，面点师已经几乎完成那件薄薄的托盘。（had nearly finished …）
那件薄薄的托盘当时几乎满。（nearly full）
保管它的那位顾客在入冬前已经差不多把它尝过两回。（had nearly tasted it）
叔叔几乎完成那件薄薄的托盘，糕饼铺里没有一个人怀疑。（… nearly …）
在那个星期里做过这件事的人当中，他做得最几乎。（the most nearly of all of them）
answers: Nearly, in 1963 the baker finished the tray at the oven.
Before the December rains the baker had nearly finished the tray.
The customer who kept it had nearly tasted it twice before the winter came.
He finished the tray nearly in silence, and nobody in the bakery doubted it.
Of all who did it that week, he did it nearly in public.

answers: Nearly, in 1963 the baker finished the tray, and nobody forgot it.
